title: Check Overall System Faults and Active AGV Faults on the Overall System RMS Page
summary: Perform a first-pass live check on the RMS / fleet status UI (Geek+ RMS web page) to determine whether the system has any system faults (left side) and whether any AGVs have active faults (right side).
when_to_use: Use when a caller reports a potential fleet/system issue and you need a quick overview of (1) system faults and (2) any active AGV faults visible on the Overall System RMS page.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Open the RMS / fleet status UI and verify whether system faults (left) and active AGV faults (right) are displayed; report findings to higher support/troubleshooting.
access_or_tools_needed: RMS / fleet status UI (Geek+ RMS web page)

access_required: Access to the RMS / fleet status UI (Geek+ RMS web page) for the site

visual_references.description: Overall System RMS page example showing system faults on the left and active AGV faults on the right (used to confirm the expected layout/areas).
Example where the Overall System RMS page may appear blank when the firewall is not open (useful for diagnosing page-load/visibility issues).

steps.title: Open the Overall System RMS page in the RMS / fleet status UI
steps.purpose: Get to the correct RMS page layout that contains the system-faults and active-AGV-faults areas.
steps.instruction: Open the RMS / fleet status UI (Geek+ RMS web page) for the site and navigate to the Overall System RMS page.
steps.expected_result: The Overall System RMS page loads and shows the two fault areas: system faults on the left and active AGV faults on the right.
steps.healthy_condition: Both left and right fault areas are visible on the Overall System RMS page.
steps.failure_condition: The Overall System RMS content needed to view the left system-faults area and right active-AGV-faults area does not load or the page appears blank.

actions.label: Verify page loaded
actions.exact_action: Open the RMS / fleet status UI (Geek+ RMS web page) for the site.

stop_or_escalate_if: RMS page cannot be reached or does not load the Overall System RMS content needed to view system faults (left) and active AGV faults (right).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR: “Overall System RMS ... This page will show the Geek+ RMS web page ... will also show system faults on the left and any ... active AGV faults on the right.”

steps.title: Check the left-side “system faults” area
steps.purpose: Determine whether the system currently has any system faults displayed on the Overall System RMS page.
steps.instruction: On the Overall System RMS page, look at the left-side “system faults” area and determine whether any system faults are listed/present.
steps.expected_result: You can state whether the left-side “system faults” area shows one or more fault entries or is empty/not showing faults at the time of the check.
steps.healthy_condition: The left-side “system faults” area shows no system faults (empty/not showing faults).
steps.failure_condition: The left-side “system faults” area lists one or more system faults.

actions.label: Inspect system faults area
actions.exact_action: Look at the left-side “system faults” area and note whether any system faults are listed/present.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR: “... will also show system faults on the left ...”

steps.title: Check the right-side “active AGV faults” area
steps.purpose: Determine whether any AGVs currently have active faults displayed on the Overall System RMS page.
steps.instruction: On the same Overall System RMS page, look at the right-side “active AGV faults” area and determine whether any active AGV faults are listed/present.
steps.expected_result: You can state whether the right-side “active AGV faults” area shows one or more fault entries or is empty/not showing faults at the time of the check.
steps.healthy_condition: The right-side “active AGV faults” area shows no active AGV faults (empty/not showing faults).
steps.failure_condition: The right-side “active AGV faults” area lists one or more active AGV faults.

actions.label: Inspect active AGV faults area
actions.exact_action: Look at the right-side “active AGV faults” area and note whether any active AGV faults are listed/present.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: OCR: “... and any ... active AGV faults on the right.”

steps.title: Report the displayed fault indications (or confirm none are displayed)
steps.purpose: Ensure the fault overview is communicated for next-step troubleshooting.
steps.instruction: If the left “system faults” area and/or the right “active AGV faults” area shows entries, report those fault indications to support. If both areas are empty/not showing faults, report that no system faults/active AGV faults are currently displayed on this page.
steps.expected_result: A clear statement is provided indicating whether system faults are present on the left and whether active AGV faults are present on the right at the time of the check.
steps.healthy_condition: Report indicates both sides show no fault entries (no system faults and no active AGV faults displayed).
steps.failure_condition: Report indicates one or both sides show fault entries, or the RMS page could not be verified.

actions.label: Communicate findings
actions.exact_action: Report those fault indications to support; if both areas are empty/not showing faults, report that no system faults/active AGV faults are currently displayed on this page.

stop_or_escalate_if: RMS page cannot be reached or does not load the Overall System RMS content needed to view system faults (left) and active AGV faults (right).
If the caller cannot share screen, ask them to navigate to the Overall System RMS page (or provide a viewable screenshot) so the left/right fault areas can be verified.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Transcript: “Do you have any system faults, right? Should be the first question.” and “Most people ... will not be able to share their screen on this.”

success_criteria: You verify the presence/absence of system faults in the left-side “system faults” area on the Overall System RMS page.
You verify the presence/absence of active AGV faults in the right-side “active AGV faults” area on the Overall System RMS page.
You report whether each side shows fault entries or is empty/not showing faults.
healthy_conditions: Left-side “system faults” area shows no system faults (empty/not showing faults).
Right-side “active AGV faults” area shows no active AGV faults (empty/not showing faults).
failure_conditions: Left-side “system faults” area lists one or more system faults.
Right-side “active AGV faults” area lists one or more active AGV faults.
Overall System RMS page cannot be reached or does not load the content needed to view the left/right fault areas.
escalation_guidance: If the RMS page cannot be reached or does not load the Overall System RMS content needed to view system faults (left) and active AGV faults (right), escalate/continue troubleshooting.
If the caller cannot share screen, request a viewable screenshot or ask them to navigate to the Overall System RMS page so the left/right fault areas can be verified.

source_refs.quote_or_summary: OCR: “Overall System RMS ... will also show system faults on the left and any ... active AGV faults on the right.” Transcript: “Do you have any system faults, right? Should be the first question.”

missing_details: Exact navigation path/click sequence to reach the Overall System RMS page within the RMS / fleet status UI is not provided in the packet; only the expected page layout (system faults left, active AGV faults right) is specified.
